prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1403; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of lumbar pain radiating into the buttock, consistent with the mechanism of injury described. Over the course of care the patient completed 20 visits, a somewhat longer course than is typical for an uncomplicated lumbar strain. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar range of motion, findings that support the reported injury. Neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and straight-leg raise, was within normal limits, and imaging did not show acute structural abnormality. No prior injury to the lumbar region is documented in the available history. Treatment consisted of manual therapy, a home exercise program, and graduated activity restrictions, with gradual improvement in pain and mobility noted over the treatment period. Billed services correspond to the visits performed, with no duplicated charges identified. Ongoing management includes a return-to-activity plan and reassessment at the next scheduled follow-up.
